verdict.rationale: An MCP-client capability is a fair question for a model runtime with its own desktop app, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence documents Ollama itself connecting to MCP servers or using their tools. Launching or connecting third-party agents like Claude Code and Codex (ollama-docs-15, ollama-gh-1) gives those external agents any MCP support, not Ollama, so it earns no credit here.
